create_mturk_datastore: create an MTurkDatastore instance to manage HIT and run mappings in a local SQLite database
register_new_hit: register a new HIT with its id, link, duration, and run_id in the datastore hits table
register_assignment_to_hit: register an assignment to a HIT by mapping hit_id, unit_id, and assignment_id together
get_client_for_requester: get an MTurk API client for a given requester name using boto3 session management
create_qualification_mapping: create a mapping between a mephisto qualification name and its MTurk qualification details
